verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs have a dedicated OTLP concepts page. It states that Sentry ingests OpenTelemetry traces and logs through OTLP endpoints, either directly from an OTel SDK or through the OpenTelemetry Collector. That covers the core of sending telemetry directly over OTLP. Missing for 10: evidence of OTLP metrics ingestion, detail on how deep the 'first-class' support goes (e.g., semantic-convention mapping, feature parity with native SDKs), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
